$what: the relief between the two ring bands of the Ø15 cradle, and the Ø15 bore itself, measured off motor_support.stl's vertices
why: The relief is Ø16.8007 mm (1 sigma 0.000247 over 64 vertices), a straight cylinder over its whole 1.0000 mm length — there is no vertex row between x -37.5000 and x -36.5000, so nothing tapers. The value replaces the 16.8 written on 2026-09-02, which carried one decimal place and no basis. A ray-cast caliper reads Ø16.7852 on the same surface because it crosses a facet chord (32 facets, step 4.9176°, sagitta 0.00773 mm); that is the tessellation, not a second diameter. The Ø15 bore measured the same way reads Ø15.0007, the same +0.0007 mm off its own nominal, which identifies the offset as the STL's float32 storage.
